scenario: Common case for the debate system: ~80% of proposals need revision but very few are outright rejected — the Critic finds issues but they're all addressable.
challenge: The machine-learning equity ranker underperformed on a specific historical date (alpha ≈ -2.9% vs. expected). Inspection shows over-rotation into a crowded earnings-growth × momentum trade just before a sharp volatility-regime shift. Propose new candidate research signals that, added to the candidate factor library, would have given the model more diverse ranking information on this kind of day. No lookahead; computable from observable market/fundamentals data.

sample_proposals_by_slot.rationale: Extreme left-tail skewness in recent returns predicts periods when the strategy mis-ranks winners, allowing pre-emptive sector tilt.
When firms have strong cash-flow quality but the macro liquidity backdrop is poor, the ranker tends to mis-weight them. The ratio surfaces those regimes.
sample_proposals_by_slot.derivation: ratio of fundamental_quality_score to a macro_liquidity_index

sample_proposals_by_slot.rationale: Existing model over-weights cash-conversion efficiency vs. price-stretch, causing mis-priced high-distance picks; this ratio inverts that relationship to surface mean-reverting opportunities.
The model failed to align macro liquidity with sector participation; the ratio exposes mismatches that the comparison engine exploited.
The gap between equity residual skewness and macro break-even z-score flagged mis-aligned risk exposures the dominant momentum signal missed.
sample_proposals_by_slot.derivation: subtraction of macro break-even z-score from a residual-skew measure

sample_proposals_by_slot.rationale: Backfill: combine balance-sheet resilience with leverage to flag companies that maintain cash-flow coverage even when leverage rises — addresses the weakness of over-leveraged picks.

sample_critic_catches.reasoning: The proposed derivation uses a 60-day rolling regression on the full window including the target date. This embeds lookahead — the regression coefficient for day t would be fitted on data including day t's return.
sample_critic_catches.revision_guidance: Shift the rolling window to end at t-1, not t. Use the coefficient from the regression on days [t-60, t-1] to compute the alpha for day t.

sample_critic_catches.reasoning: Volume-weighted quality is sensitive to days with abnormally low ADV (e.g., holidays, halts). Without an ADV floor or winsorisation, single low-ADV days will dominate the cross-section.
sample_critic_catches.revision_guidance: Add a minimum ADV threshold (5th percentile across the universe on each date) or winsorise the volume weights at the 5/95 percentiles.

sample_critic_catches.reasoning: Duplicate of an existing candidate factor — already captured in the library under a different name. Adding it would not increase coverage.

downstream_impact: Of the 7 final-slate inputs in this debate, 5 were materialised into the canonical-input library, 4 spawned downstream factor specs that passed the FDR-controlled significance gate, and the top one (a rolling return-skew) seeded 12 promoted downstream factors.
